name: palmagent
description: Palmagent skills for settings, installation, diagnosis, updates, and dispatching a local Claude or Codex session to the self-hosted dispatcher.

interface.shortDescription: Install, reconfigure, diagnose, and update a self-hosted dispatcher
interface.longDescription: Operator skins over the palmagent CLI. Install a new instance, reconfigure an existing one, diagnose a broken one against systemd + journal logs, and update in place while preserving in-flight agent turns. The CLI is the brain; these skills add conversational confirmation and adaptive diagnosis.
